name: dbui
description: Schema-driven web app with 5 backends: Apps Script, OAuth Sheets, CRDT Drive sync, Firebase Firestore, local SQLite

scripts.test:e2e-firebase: node run-with-emulators.mjs --only auth,firestore,storage --project demo-app -- npx playwright test test-ui/firebase-emulator.spec.js
scripts.test:storage-rules: node run-with-emulators.mjs --only storage,firestore --project demo-image -- node test-emulator/storage-rules.mjs
scripts.test:rules: node run-with-emulators.mjs --only firestore --project demo-rules -- node test-emulator/firestore-rules.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:rules && npm run test:storage-rules && npm run test:e2e-firebase && npm run test:ui
